reference_oracle_policy: Use independent golden data/spec/reference source for correctness; do not rely only on pack/unpack roundtrips. No imports of device constructors.

cases.name: 无副作用入口
cases.inputs: import/construct/list with fake filesystem, libusb and GPIO spies
cases.expected: No device open/control/reset/flash/role write; runtime gate remains denied
cases.required_evidence: call trace and negative assertion results

cases.name: 未绑定与歧义身份
cases.inputs: empty/duplicate identities, two same-type boards, wrong transport, extra unexpected board
cases.expected: Reject or quarantine; do not choose first device or infer MCU from casing
cases.required_evidence: binding error matrix and synthetic profile fixtures

cases.name: 角色与能力契约
cases.inputs: missing vehicle/harness/ignition/peripheral roles; inconsistent CAN-FD capability
cases.expected: Cannot instantiate active group; unknown remains unknown
cases.required_evidence: profile validation report, no actual device identifiers

cases.name: 版本协商分代
cases.inputs: 0xdd current f512bcff76f2ab75 bytes; legacy 10 04 05; lengths 0..7 or >8; unknown hashes
cases.expected: Current exact 8-byte pair accepted only for pinned ABI; legacy only decoder; short/unknown fails before control
cases.required_evidence: independent byte vectors, parser outputs and rejection tests

cases.name: health精确语义
cases.inputs: legacy58/current48/CAN-health64 bytes, bit flags, widths, interrupt scaling, absent fields, all truncations; unknown fault bits/enums, NaN/Inf legacy load, width overflow and unsupported sensors
cases.expected: Exact-size decoding; correct units/flags; unavailable fields explicitly unsupported; no zero-filled healthy short read; invalid or unknown mandatory health semantics make the session unusable; no unsafe numeric cast or invented normal value
cases.required_evidence: field-by-field golden table and C/Python comparison; generated sizeof/offsetof later

cases.name: CAN边界和分片
cases.inputs: 0..8-byte classic payloads; all legal FD DLCs; std/extended address bounds; every header/payload split point; USB64 boundaries
cases.expected: Correct roundtrip against independent oracle; no 64-byte counter assumption; bounded incomplete frame storage
cases.required_evidence: golden bytes plus property/fuzz seeds; not merely implementation self-roundtrip

cases.name: 能力与坏帧
cases.inputs: F4 receives FD-bit or payload>8; invalid local bus; bad XOR; both returned+rejected flags; oversized frame
cases.expected: Explicit reject/error; no truncation, capability promotion, auto-reset or automatic retry with writes
cases.required_evidence: negative vector table and zero control-write trace

cases.name: 原始协议与主机逻辑区分
cases.inputs: wire bytes, normalized frame, host src with flags and slot offset
cases.expected: Keep wire framing, safety semantics and host routing distinct; no old safety enum substitution
cases.required_evidence: reviewed normalized data contract and golden translations

cases.name: 版本特定结构和头部边界
cases.inputs: SP098 health16 versus DP reference17; C++ reserved bit versus MCU/Python FD bit; 0..5 byte CAN header fragments
cases.expected: Never parse version16 with version17 layout; exact version/length whitelist; unify FD semantics; safe length-before-subtraction/check-before-copy and no auto reset on incomplete data
cases.required_evidence: independent ABI fixtures, compiler sanitizer run and every short-header prefix case

cases.name: 传输返回值
cases.inputs: mock success/short read/timeout/STALL/disconnect/cancel and partial write
cases.expected: Result includes exact actual length/error; no unbounded retries; unsent/uncertain CAN data never replayed automatically
cases.required_evidence: mock transcript, bounded attempt counts, no duplicate frame oracle

cases.name: 双handle隔离
cases.inputs: A blocked, B healthy, then disconnect A; concurrent control/bulk calls
cases.expected: Per-handle locks/errors; B scheduling progresses; shared buffers never mix; group validity can still fail
cases.required_evidence: deterministic scheduler trace and per-handle buffer checks

cases.name: SPI不退化
cases.inputs: pinned single-H7 SPI behavior with mocked transport
cases.expected: Same supported wire output/semantics; no USB fallback on SPI failure without explicit profile
cases.required_evidence: before/after golden output comparison

cases.name: 可移植构建边界
cases.inputs: pure-core host target on macOS; full USB/SPI host link on Linux environment
cases.expected: Each scope builds/tests separately; macOS minimal never substituted for Linux pandad
cases.required_evidence: compiler/link logs and platform-labelled test reports

cases.name: 调度与取消预算
cases.inputs: All read/write/lock/queue/health-age/heartbeat/cancel paths; one blocked board; threshold-1/threshold/threshold+1 and timer wrap
cases.expected: Before implementation acceptance freeze numeric deadlines, queue capacities and age limits with source/rationale; fake clock proves bounded cancellation and fairness, no unbounded retries or starvation
cases.required_evidence: versioned timing-budget table plus virtual-clock traces for every boundary

cases.name: 稳定槽位
cases.inputs: DOS/red profile both permutations; USB enumeration reversed; synthetic identical models with distinct bindings
cases.expected: Stable slot independent of enumeration and type sorting; neither physical order is assumed real
cases.required_evidence: permutation fixture outcomes

cases.name: 双向总线映射
cases.inputs: slot0 local0/1/2 and slot1 local0/1/2; reserved host3/7; all src flags
cases.expected: Ordinary 0/1/2 and4/5/6 map once; MCU sees0/1/2; TX flags/reserved/unknown buses rejected
cases.required_evidence: 6-route bidirectional matrix, forbidden-route zero-count assertions

cases.name: 掉板与替板
cases.inputs: disconnect/reconnect/identity change at partial RX and queued TX; address reuse
cases.expected: Keep slot reserved; increment epoch; discard stale partial/queued data; replacement must rebind; no surviving-board promotion
cases.required_evidence: epoch transition log and no-cross-session frame proof

cases.name: 时间和队列
cases.inputs: old/future sendcan timestamps, long queue delay, mixed-board RX, queue overflow; sendcan Event.valid=false; delayed queued RX and republishing
cases.expected: Reject expired/future/old-epoch TX; per-board order kept; overflow visible; no claimed cross-board hardware synchronization; invalid sendcan is rejected; aggregate publishing preserves original receive age and never renews freshness of old RX
cases.required_evidence: virtual-clock cases, queue bounds and reported loss counters

cases.name: 仅完整组可用
cases.inputs: one required board missing, late discovery, reconnect with unknown protocol
cases.expected: Publish group unavailable, zero routed vehicle TX, no automatic one-board degradation
cases.required_evidence: two-board state machine trace

cases.name: 固定健康列表
cases.inputs: 0/1/2/3 discovered devices, one stale/short health, reused previous value
cases.expected: Exactly2 configured slots when publishing this profile; any missing/stale required slot makes Event.valid false; no healthy placeholder
cases.required_evidence: serialized pandaStates fixtures and consumer reactions

cases.name: safety屏障
cases.inputs: 2 safetyConfigs with per-slot params and alternativeExperience; empty/short/extra configs; one readback mismatch
cases.expected: No simulated control TX until all configured identities/versions/safety readbacks match; unused board noOutput explicit; no index0 replication
cases.required_evidence: per-board command/readback transcript and denied-TX counters

cases.name: 消费者缺板检测
cases.inputs: missing fixed slot, invalid Event, stale data; different vehicle/harness slots
cases.expected: selfdrived/hardwared/UI fail required-count/validity/freshness checks; no accidental promotion of index0
cases.required_evidence: consumer tests against frozen schema and role profile

cases.name: 诊断和车辆查询隔离
cases.inputs: firmware query/multiplexing requests before vehicle role or policy is bound
cases.expected: No implicit ELM327/query/sendcan on both boards; diagnostics remain off in offline/default profile
cases.required_evidence: mock control/CAN trace with forbidden calls absent

cases.name: 外围角色和点火
cases.inputs: DOS local ignition=false while vehicle board ignition=true; missing peripherals; no cabin camera; diagnostic board differs from vehicle/harness/fan boards
cases.expected: System ignition uses configured sources; no accidental DOS power-save; fan/current/harness chosen by role; unavailable IR not written; OBD/VIN/firmware queries use explicit diagnostic role and remain disabled in passive/offline scope
cases.required_evidence: role-specific command routing matrix; no fake ignition injection

cases.name: 故障组退出
cases.inputs: failed required board during engagement, healthy sibling, frozen selfdriveState
cases.expected: Close host TX gate on observed invalidation within frozen bound; reject stale enabled state; healthy sibling gets bounded explicit exit/heartbeat handling. Separately prove MCU heartbeat timeout enters SILENT and software-watchdog fault reporting; do not equate software-watchdog fault with immediate SILENT or claim hardware watchdog recovery.
cases.required_evidence: virtual-clock transition and write-intent traces; hardware behavior remains untested

cases.name: 外围状态失效
cases.inputs: Stale fan/deviceState command; internal-board disconnect; missing sensor; required-board fault while fan board remains reachable
cases.expected: Reject stale peripheral commands; make capability/role-specific thermal exit and heartbeat policy explicit and bounded; loss of observability/required board closes control group. Do not invent safe physical fan output for unknown hardware
cases.required_evidence: mock peripheral traces and independent thermal/heartbeat transition matrix; hardware cooling behavior remains untested

cases.name: F4来源完整性
cases.inputs: pinned legacy BSP source/license, startup/linker/USB/bxCAN/clock/interrupt/watchdog dependencies
cases.expected: No missing private binary dependency; thin archived DOS header alone fails complete-source gate
cases.required_evidence: source inventory, licenses and commit/hash manifest

cases.name: 分MCU构建
cases.inputs: F4 candidate app and retained H7 app using pinned current opendbc safety and toolchain
cases.expected: Independent clean compile/link; warnings treated as errors; separate artifacts; no bootstub replacement or device install
cases.required_evidence: compile logs, ELF/linker map, toolchain/pin/artifact hashes

cases.name: ABI跨语言一致
cases.inputs: C firmware/test compile on both MCU targets, C++ host and Python formats
cases.expected: sizeof/offsetof/alignment/hash/endianness agree; health48, CAN-health64 and expected wire bytes checked; CANPacket_t size measured not guessed
cases.required_evidence: generated ABI report and static assertions, hash recalculation

cases.name: F4资源预算
cases.inputs: F4-specific RX/TX queue dimensions, stacks, DMA-capable memory, boot/app/provisioning regions
cases.expected: No copying H7 ~384768-byte data queues into F4; documented capacity bound and reserve, linker failures for exceeded/unknown bounds; no section overlaps
cases.required_evidence: memory/stack report and enforced linker limits; real silicon capacity remains unverified

cases.name: MCU差异适配
cases.inputs: bxCAN versus FDCAN, IRQ/timer wraparound, watchdog/heartbeat, unsupported peripheral fields
cases.expected: Common API retains correct semantics with capability rejection; no fabricated FD or sensor capability; timing assumptions explicit
cases.required_evidence: host-mocked low-level tests plus required later hardware-test list

cases.name: bootstub边界
cases.inputs: candidate app start/address/signature versus known and unknown installed bootstub
cases.expected: Unknown compatibility prevents deployment package; app build does not authorize bootstub change; no key/provisioning copied
cases.required_evidence: artifact contract and rejection manifest

cases.name: safety同源与本地总线
cases.inputs: same current safety sources F4/H7; noOutput and allowed test modes; local-bus negatives
cases.expected: Correct current safety API; local0/1/2 only; noOutput forbids TX; wrong bus/DLC/checksum/counter/timeout rejected per chosen model
cases.required_evidence: safety test reports labelled host/MCU target; no vehicle claim

cases.name: 旧BYD配置不混用
cases.inputs: legacy enum32/param33 versus pinned enum35/ATTO3 implementation
cases.expected: Cannot select new safety by translating an integer or retain private legacy firmware semantics; Song PLUS unavailable
cases.required_evidence: negative config fixture with explicit unsupported reason

cases.name: 复合故障注入
cases.inputs: bad checksum + disconnect + stale health + reconnect; queue overflow; one board delayed
cases.expected: Group invalid, zero new control TX, no replay of prior commands, clear diagnostic cause, no auto flash/reset/recover
cases.required_evidence: deterministic integration trace and event assertions

cases.name: 单H7回归和构建覆盖
cases.inputs: existing relevant pure codec/safety tests; new fake USB integration; Linux host build
cases.expected: No regression in declared supported H7/SPI path; hardware-starting existing tests excluded or separately classified
cases.required_evidence: actual pass/fail/skip counts, test inventory, compiler logs

cases.name: 拒绝发送不可绕板
cases.inputs: MCU TX rejected, relay malfunction, FWD blocked, safety mismatch and host-visible error during dual-board operation
cases.expected: Preserve original board and local-bus decision; never retry rejected/blocked CAN on sibling, change safety mode, spoof RX, or route through diagnostic path to bypass rejection
cases.required_evidence: negative route traces showing zero alternate-board or alternate-mode send attempts

cases.name: 退出与断电边界
cases.inputs: SIGINT and normal exit, exit while engaged, disconnect holding transport lock, process death, USB power loss
cases.expected: Planned shutdown closes TX and cancels work within frozen bound; reachable sibling exit handled independently; abrupt process/power death modeled separately through MCU heartbeat expiry. No claim that finally blocks execute after power loss
cases.required_evidence: virtual-clock/cancellation traces and separate normal-shutdown versus abrupt-death reports

cases.name: 维护入口隔离
cases.inputs: runtime wrapper sees unknown board/protocol/signature, build missing artifact
cases.expected: Report unavailable; never auto-download, build-and-install, enter DFU, toggle role or replace bootstub
cases.required_evidence: negative subprocess/device-spy trace

cases.name: 可复现补丁和产物
cases.inputs: clean pinned source plus ordered downstream patches and cached dependencies
cases.expected: Rebuild with no network/device; patch applicability and pin drift fail clearly; per-MCU hash/version metadata consistent
cases.required_evidence: downstream lock, patch hashes, artifact metadata, offline rebuild logs

cases.name: 完成状态不越界
cases.inputs: all required offline cases, remaining unknown hardware/recovery/DM/vehicle conditions
cases.expected: Only mark offline compatibility complete when all required cases run/pass; never auto-mark deployment/recovery/vehicle ready
cases.required_evidence: scoped acceptance report separating host/F4/H7/target/vehicle
